## 2. Project Structure & Modules

**`settings.gradle.kts`** includes 5 modules:

| Module | Path | Type | Namespace |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:app` | `app/` | Application | `com.android.purebilibili` |
| `:baselineprofile` | `baselineprofile/` | Test (macrobenchmark) | `com.android.purebilibili.baselineprofile` |
| `:settings-core` | `settings-core/` | Library | `com.android.purebilibili.settings.core` |
| `:network-core` | `network-core/` | Library | `com.android.purebilibili.network.core` |
| `:plugin-sdk` | `plugin-sdk/` | Library (publishable) | `com.android.purebilibili.plugin.sdk` |

**`:network-core`** -- Contains pure policy classes for network fallback (hardcoded DNS, trust-all-certs toggle) and home feed anonymizer cookie policy. No external dependencies beyond test libraries.

**`:settings-core`** -- Contains `PlaybackSpeedPolicy.kt` only. A minimal library for shared playback speed policy logic.

**`:plugin-sdk`** -- Publishable SDK (`maven-publish`, group `com.github.jay3-yy.BiliPai`, version `0.1.0-SNAPSHOT`). Uses `kotlinx-serialization-json`. Contains:
- `PluginCapabilityManifest.kt` -- capability declaration (PLAYER_STATE, DANMAKU_STREAM, NETWORK, etc.)
- `PlayerPluginApi.kt`, `DanmakuPluginApi.kt`, `RecommendationPluginApi.kt`

**`:baselineprofile`** -- Macrobenchmark module targeting `:app`, uses a managed Pixel 6 / API 31 virtual device, enables Perfetto tracing.

### Additional root-level directories
- `commonMain/` and `androidMain/` -- contain only a `dev/` subfolder (likely placeholder or future KMP structure)
- `plugins/` -- contains `community/`, `samples/`, `sdk/`, `tools/` (plugin ecosystem)
- `docs/`, `examples/`, `scripts/` -- documentation and tooling

## 3. Key Source Files & Architecture

### Main package: `com.android.purebilibili`

The project follows a **clean-ish architecture** with these top-level packages:

```
com.android.purebilibili/
  app/          -- Application class, DI placeholder, startup orchestrator, notification channels
  core/         -- Cross-cutting infrastructure
    cache/       -- PlayUrlCache
    cooldown/    -- PlaybackCooldownManager
    coroutines/  -- AppScope (IO/Default scopes)
    database/    -- Room: AppDatabase, Converters, DAOs, entities
    lifecycle/   -- BackgroundManager (foreground/background detection)
    network/     -- ApiClient, NetworkModule, Interceptors, WbiKeyManager, WbiUtils, AppSignUtils, TokenRefreshHelper, grpc/, socket/
    player/      -- BasePlayerViewModel, PlaybackMediaCache, PlayerVolumeController
    plugin/      -- PluginManager, Plugin interface, json/ (JsonPluginManager, RuleEngine), js/ (BiliPaiJsRuntime), kotlinpkg/, skin/
    refresh/     -- Pull-to-refresh
    store/       -- SettingsManager (DataStore), TokenManager, PlayerSettingsCache, AccountSessionStore, home/, navigation/, player/ sub-stores
    theme/       -- Color, Theme, Type, Shape, UiPreset, adaptive accent color, Android native variant theme
    ui/          -- Design system, adaptive layouts, blur, components, animation, motion, transition, wallpaper, iOS-style components
    util/        -- Logger, CrashReporter, AnalyticsHelper, FormatUtils, NetworkUtils, BilibiliUrlParser, etc.
  data/
    model/       -- entity/, response/ (DTOs), VideoQuality, VideoLoadError, CommentFraudStatus
    repository/ -- 35+ repository classes (VideoRepository, LiveRepository, DynamicRepository, CommentRepository, SearchRepository, etc.)
  domain/
    usecase/     -- SponsorBlockUseCase, UserInteractionUseCase
  feature/       -- 27 feature packages (see below)
  navigation/    -- AppNavigation, ScreenRoutes, policies (navigation appearance, playback, top-level, deep link, etc.)
  navigation3/   -- BiliPaiNavKey (sealed interface), BiliPaiNavDisplayHost, back stack controller, predictive back, motion policies
```

### Architecture patterns

**ViewModel pattern**: Heavy use of `androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel` with `viewModelScope`. Key ViewModels:
- `HomeViewModel`, `VideoPlaybackViewModel`, `VideoCommentViewModel`, `VideoEngagementViewModel`, `VideoComposerViewModel`, `VideoSupplementViewModel`
- `LivePlayerViewModel`, `SearchViewModel`, `SearchTrendingViewModel`, `StoryViewModel`, `SettingsViewModel`
- `BasePlayerViewModel` -- abstract base for video/bangumi player sharing ExoPlayer management + SponsorBlock logic

**UseCase pattern**: Domain layer is thin but present:
- `VideoPlaybackUseCase` -- handles video loading, quality switching, page switching
- `SponsorBlockUseCase`, `UserInteractionUseCase`

**Policy pattern**: Extensively used throughout the codebase. Nearly every feature has dedicated `*Policy.kt` files that encapsulate decision logic separate from UI/viewmodel code. Examples:
- `HomeFeedGridPolicy`, `HomeGlassVisualPolicy`, `HomeHeroCarouselPolicy`, `HomePerformancePolicy`
- `VideoLoadPolicy`, `VideoCastPolicy`, `PlaybackHeartbeatPolicy`, `PlaybackCompletionBehaviorSyncPolicy`
- `DanmakuKeywordFilterPolicy`, `DanmakuTypeFilterPolicy`, `DanmakuPlaybackSyncPolicy`
- `SearchLoadPolicy`, `SearchRecommendPolicy`
- `NetworkFallbackPolicy`, `HomeFeedAnonymizerPolicy`
- `BlurBudgetPolicy`, `BlurIntensityVisualPolicy`
- `BiliPaiNavMotionPolicy`, `BiliPaiNavContentTransformPolicy`
- `DownloadQueuePolicy`, `DownloadResumePolicy`, `DownloadStoragePolicy`

**Repository pattern**: 35+ repository objects in `data/repository/`, all using singleton `object` pattern with `suspend` functions. They call `NetworkModule`'s Retrofit API interfaces directly.

**DI framework**: **None**. The project does NOT use Hilt, Dagger, or Koin. The `app/di.kt` file is an empty placeholder class. Dependencies are managed through:
- Singleton `object` pattern (NetworkModule, SettingsManager, TokenManager, PluginManager, etc.)
- Direct construction in ViewModels
- `PureApplication` as the composition root, manually initializing everything in `AppStartupOrchestrator`

### Feature packages (27 total)
`article`, `audio`, `bangumi`, `cast`, `category`, `common`, `download`, `dynamic`, `following`, `home`, `list`, `live`, `livesite`, `login`, `message`, `onboarding`, `partition`, `plugin`, `privacy`, `profile`, `screenshot`, `search`, `settings`, `space`, `story`, `video`, `watchlater`, `web`

### Navigation system

**Navigation3** (`androidx.navigation3`) -- the new experimental type-safe Compose navigation library, NOT the classic Navigation Compose. Key elements:
- `BiliPaiNavKey` -- `@Serializable sealed interface NavKey` with 30+ route definitions (MainHost, Home, Dynamic, Search, Settings, SettingsCategory, VideoDetail, BangumiDetail, LiveRoom, etc.)
- `BiliPaiNavDisplayHost` -- custom `NavDisplay` host with extensive shared element transitions, predictive back animation, video card morph transitions
- `BiliPaiNavBackStackController` / `BiliPaiNavBackStackPolicy` -- custom back stack management
- `predictiveback/` -- custom predictive back animation handlers (`BiliPaiPredictiveBackAnimationHandler`, `SCALE`/`AOSP` exit styles)
- Vendored `androidx.navigationevent.compose` source for fine-grained control over `onBackCompleted` timing
- `ScreenRoutes.kt` -- legacy route string definitions (used alongside NavKey)

## 4. Player and Media

### Video playback: **Media3 / ExoPlayer 1.10.0**
- `androidx.media3:media3-exoplayer` -- core ExoPlayer
- `media3-exoplayer-dash` -- DASH streaming for Bilibili's separated audio/video (DASH manifest)
- `media3-exoplayer-hls` -- HLS live streams
- `media3-datasource-okhttp` -- OkHttp-backed data source (shares NetworkModule's OkHttpClient for DNS fixes)
- `media3-ui` -- PlayerView composable
- `media3-session` -- MediaSession for system media controls

**Player architecture:**
- `BasePlayerViewModel` -- abstract base managing ExoPlayer lifecycle, SponsorBlock segment loading/skipping, DASH media source construction (MergingMediaSource for separate audio+video)
- `VideoPlaybackViewModel` -- full video playback orchestration via `VideoPlaybackUseCase`; manages quality switching, playback coordinator, playlist, CDN health
- `VideoPlaybackUseCase` -- constructs `DashMediaSource`, `AdaptiveDashPlaybackSource`, builds local DASH manifests (`buildLocalDashManifest`)
- `MiniPlayerManager` -- singleton managing background/mini-player; creates `MediaSession`, builds media notification with playback controls, uses `ForwardingPlayer`
- `PlaybackService` -- foreground service (`foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback"`) that promotes MiniPlayerManager's notification to foreground for background playback
- `PlaylistManager` -- playlist queue management
- `PlayerVolumeController` -- preferred volume management

### Danmaku (bullet comments): **ByteDance DanmakuRenderEngine v0.1.0**
- `DanmakuManager` -- wraps `com.bytedance.danmaku.render.engine.DanmakuView`, manages danmaku lifecycle synced to ExoPlayer position
- `DanmakuParser` -- maps Bilibili danmaku types to DanmakuRenderEngine layer types (scroll, top-center, bottom-center)
- `DanmakuProto` -- protobuf/brotli protocol parsing for live danmaku
- `DanmakuMerger`, `DanmakuConfig`, `CommandDanmakuPolicy`, `DanmakuKeywordFilterPolicy`, `FaceOcclusionPolicy`
- Used in both video player (`VideoPlayerSection`) and bangumi player (`BangumiPlayerComponents`)

### Live streaming
- `LiveDanmakuClient` -- WebSocket client for Bilibili live danmaku with auto-reconnect (exponential backoff), auth, heartbeat, backpressure (Channel with DROP_OLDEST), Brotli decompression (ProtoVer=3)
- `DanmakuProtocol` -- live danmaku binary protocol parsing
- `LivePlayerViewModel`, `LivePlayerScreen`, `LivePlayerPipPolicy`

### AI audio
- `AiAudioInfo` model in `VideoLoadResult.Success` -- supports AI-translated audio tracks
- `AiSummaryFetchPolicy`, `AiSummaryRetryPolicy`, `AiSummaryUiPolicy` -- AI content summary features

## 5. Networking

### HTTP client stack
- **Retrofit 2.12.0** with **kotlinx-serialization-converter** (no Gson/Moshi)
- **OkHttp 5.3.2** with custom DNS, cookie jar, HTTP/2, disk cache (32MB), connection pool, trust-all in debug
- **kotlinx-serialization-json 1.11.0** for all JSON (de)serialization

### NetworkModule (singleton)
Located at `app/src/main/java/com/android/purebilibili/core/network/ApiClient.kt` (~2500 lines). Key elements:
- `okHttpClient` -- main client with: 15s connect / 20s read timeout, 32MB disk cache, custom Dns implementation with hardcoded IP fallback, AppSessionCookieJar, Referer/Origin/User-Agent injection per endpoint, WBI signature exclusion
- `playbackOkHttpClient` -- derived from main client with `Proxy.NO_PROXY` (avoids local proxy apps breaking streaming)
- `guestOkHttpClient` -- credential-free client for risk-control fallback (-351 error)
- 15+ Retrofit service interfaces for different Bilibili API domains (api.bilibili.com, passport.bilibili.com, app.bilibili.com, api.vc.bilibili.com, www.bilibili.com, api.live.bilibili.com)

### API security/auth layers
- `WbiKeyManager` / `WbiUtils` -- WBI signature (Bilibili's anti-tampering parameter signing for `/wbi/` endpoints)
- `AppSignUtils` -- app-level API signing
- `TokenRefreshHelper` -- token refresh logic
- `AppSessionCookieJar` -- in-memory cookie store with auto buvid3 injection, SESSDATA management, home feed anonymizer

### gRPC (custom implementation)
- `BiliGrpcClient` (`core/network/grpc/`) -- custom gRPC-over-HTTP using OkHttp (not gRPC library); uses `ProtoWire` for framing/unframing, `application/grpc` content-type, gzip encoding, trace IDs, access token auth
- `ViewGrpcRepository`, `CommentGrpcRepository` -- gRPC-backed repositories for comments and video views
- No `.proto` files found; protobuf wire format is handled manually via `ProtoWire`

### WebSocket
- `LiveDanmakuClient` (`core/network/socket/`) -- OkHttp WebSocket for Bilibili live danmaku; binary protocol with Brotli decompression, auth, heartbeat, health check, backpressure

### Data models
- `data/model/response/` -- extensive DTO classes for all Bilibili API responses
- `data/model/entity/` -- Room entities
- `VideoQuality`, `VideoLoadError`, `CommentFraudStatus` -- domain models

---

## 6. Data Persistence

### Room database (2.8.4)
- `AppDatabase` (`core/database/AppDatabase.kt`) -- version 4, `exportSchema=false`
- **Entities**: `SearchHistory`, `BlockedUp` (blocked users with level, sign, vipLabel, officialTitle, follower, archiveCount, isDeleted, lastSyncedAt)
- **DAOs**: `SearchHistoryDao`, `BlockedUpDao`
- Migrations: `MIGRATION_3_4` (adds columns to blocked_ups), `fallbackToDestructiveMigration(dropAllTables=true)`
- `Converters.kt` -- Room type converters
- `DatabaseModule.kt` -- database initialization

### DataStore (1.2.1)
- `SettingsManager` (`core/store/SettingsManager.kt`) -- main settings store using `preferencesDataStore(name = "settings_prefs")`; manages theme, language, blur intensity, player settings, sponsor block, danmaku defaults, app icon, privacy mode, and 100+ other settings
- `TokenManager` -- auth tokens (SESSDATA, buvid3, csrf, accessToken, mid, isVip) cached in memory + persisted
- `PlayerSettingsCache` -- cached player settings for fast access
- `AccountSessionStore`, `FollowingCacheStore`, `TodayWatchFeedbackStore`, `TodayWatchProfileStore`, `SplashWallpaperHistoryPolicy` -- specialized stores
- Sub-stores: `home/HomeSettingsStore`, `navigation/NavigationSettingsStore`, `player/PlayerSettingsStore`

### SharedPreferences (legacy/sync access)
- `crash_tracking`, `analytics_tracking`, `theme_cache`, `app_icon_cache` -- used for synchronous reads during splash/startup where DataStore's async API is unsuitable

### Cache
- `PlayUrlCache` (`core/cache/`) -- in-memory play URL caching
- `PlaybackMediaCache` -- media source caching
- Subtitle cue cache (512 entries max)

## 7. UI Specifics

### Compose UI structure
- 100% Jetpack Compose UI (no XML layouts for screens)
- `androidx.activity:activity-compose` as the entry point
- `MainActivity` extends `AppCompatActivity`, uses `installSplashScreen()`, `enableEdgeToEdge()`, hosts a `ComposeView`
- `VideoActivity` -- separate activity for video playback with `singleTop` launch mode and PIP support

### Material version
- **Material3 1.5.0-alpha18** (pre-release) with `compose-bom:2026.03.01`
- Window size class support: `material3-window-size-class`

### Adaptive layouts
- `core/ui/adaptive/` -- `MotionTier`, adaptive scaffold policies, side navigation rail policy
- `AdaptiveChrome`, `AdaptiveLoadingIndicator`, `AdaptiveNavigation`, `AdaptivePullToRefreshBox`, `AdaptiveTooltip`
- `TabletVideoLayout`, `TabletCinemaLayout`, `TabletVideoLayoutPolicy` -- tablet-specific video layouts
- `SearchTabletLayoutPolicy`, `AudioModeScreen`, `PortraitDetailPresentationPolicy`
- `androidx.window:window` for window metrics
- `WindowWidthSizeClass` utility in core/util

### Custom UI components

**Blur/Haze:**
- `dev.chrisbanes.haze:haze:1.7.2` + `haze-materials` -- frosted glass effects
- `core/ui/blur/UnifiedBlur.kt` -- unified blur intensity system
- `RecoverableVisualEffects.kt`, `BlurBudgetPolicy.kt`, `BlurIntensityVisualPolicy.kt`, `BlurStyles.kt`
- Miuix blur library (`miuix-blur-android`) for native blur rendering

**Liquid glass / Backdrop:**
- `io.github.kyant0:backdrop:2.0.0-alpha03` -- lens refraction, glass highlights, continuous corners (visionOS-style)

**iOS-style components:**
- `cupertino:0.1.0-alpha04` -- iOS-style Switch, Button, Picker, Dialog
- `iOSDialogComponents.kt`, `iOSLargeTitleBar.kt`, `iOSSheetComponents.kt`, `IOSSlidingSegmentedControl.kt`
- `IosContinuousCornerShape.kt` -- iOS-style continuous corner shapes
- Cupertino icons (800+ SF Symbols)

**Miuix components:**
- `miuix-ui`, `miuix-preference`, `miuix-shader`, `miuix-squircle` -- squircle shapes, shaders, preference UI

**Other custom components:**
- `LottieComponents.kt` -- Lottie animation composables
- `ModernComponents.kt`, `PresetPrimitiveRenderer.kt`
- `SharedTransitionProvider.kt` -- shared element transitions
- `SplashWallpaperLayout` -- custom splash wallpaper
- `HomeWallpaperBackdrop.kt` -- home screen wallpaper backdrop
- `TopReadabilityChrome.kt`, `SystemBarCompat.kt`
- `AppSquircleModifiers.kt`, `AppSurfaceTokens.kt`, `AppChromeSizeTokens.kt`

### Player overlays
- `VideoDetailOverlayHost.kt` -- orchestrates all video detail overlays (download, favorite, feedback, input, portrait, player settings)
- `MiniPlayerOverlay.kt` -- floating mini player overlay with PIP support
- `VideoPlayerSection.kt` (~3000+ lines) -- main player section with DanmakuView overlay, gesture controls, quality selector
- `VideoDetailTransitionHost.kt`, `VideoDetailPlayerTransitionHost.kt` -- shared element transitions between feed cards and player
- `PlaybackUserActionTracker` -- tracks user playback actions

### Design system
- `DesignSystem.kt` (`BiliDesign` object) -- centralized color, spacing, corner radius, animation duration definitions with iOS-inspired palette
- `core/theme/` -- `Theme.kt`, `Color.kt`, `Type.kt`, `Shape.kt`, `UiPreset.kt`, `AppFontFileStore.kt` (custom font file loading), `ThemeContrastPolicy.kt`, `ThemeRoleOverridePolicy.kt`, `AndroidNativeVariantThemePolicy.kt`

---

## 8. Native Android APIs

### Foreground services
- **`PlaybackService`** -- `foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback"`, registered as `MediaSessionService` in manifest; promotes mini player notification to foreground for background audio playback
- **`SystemForegroundService`** (WorkManager) -- `foregroundServiceType="dataSync"` for download tasks
- `DownloadWorker` (`WorkManager`) -- background video download with progress notification

### Picture-in-Picture (PIP)
- `android:supportsPictureInPicture="true"` on `MainActivity` and all splash activity aliases (7 total)
- `LivePlayerPipPolicy.kt` -- PIP policy for live streams
- PIP handling in `VideoActivity`, `VideoDetailPlatformPolicy`, `VideoDetailScreenStateHolder`, `AudioModeScreen`, `MiniPlayerOverlay`
- `enableOnBackInvokedCallback="true"` in manifest for predictive back support

### Deep links
Extensive deep link handling in `AndroidManifest.xml`:
- `https://www.bilibili.com/video/` (auto-verified) -- video deep links
- `https://live.bilibili.com/` -- live room
- `https://space.bilibili.com/` -- user space
- `https://t.bilibili.com/` -- dynamic (post)
- `https://b23.tv/` (auto-verified) -- short links
- `bilibili://` and `bili://` schemes -- app scheme
- `bilipai://` scheme -- app shortcuts
- `https://bilipai.app/plugin/install` -- plugin installation links
- `text/plain` SEND intent -- share text links into the app
- `BilibiliLinkNavigationPolicy.kt`, `BilibiliNavigationTargetParser`, `BilibiliUrlParser` -- URL parsing and routing

### App shortcuts
- `@xml/shortcuts` referenced via `android.app.shortcuts` meta-data on multiple launcher aliases

### Notification channels
4 channels defined in `AppNotificationChannels.kt`:
1. `media_playback_channel` -- "Media Playback" (IMPORTANCE_LOW)
2. `download_channel` -- "Download Tasks" (IMPORTANCE_LOW)
3. `sponsor_block_channel` -- "SponsorBlock" (IMPORTANCE_LOW)
4. `json_plugin_stats_channel` -- "Plugin Statistics" (IMPORTANCE_LOW)

### App icons (activity aliases)
The app supports **dynamic app icon switching** via 30+ activity-aliases:
- Icon variants: 3D, BiliPai, BiliPai Pink, BiliPai White, BiliPai Monet, Flat, Telegram Blue, Dark, Yuki, Anime, Headphone
- Each with optional "No Icon Splash" variant (transparent splash)
- State managed via `PackageManager.setComponentEnabledSetting()`
- Reinstall detection and automatic reset to default icon

### Biometric authentication
- `androidx.biometric:biometric:1.1.0` -- `BiometricPrompt` used in `MainActivity` for app lock

### FileProvider
- `androidx.core.content.FileProvider` with `${applicationId}.fileprovider` authority -- for log export sharing

### WiFi/Multicast (DLNA)
- `ACCESS_WIFI_STATE`, `CHANGE_WIFI_STATE`, `CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE`, `NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES` -- for SSDP multicast discovery
- `WifiManager.MulticastLock` acquired during SSDP discovery
- `ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`, `ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION` -- for local network discovery

### Startup optimization
- `AppStartupOrchestrator` -- two-phase startup: `BEFORE_FIRST_INTERACTIVE` (network init, token init, WBI keys, video repo, background manager, player settings cache, notification channels, playlist, telemetry, plugins, dex2oat profile) and `AFTER_FIRST_INTERACTIVE` (deferred via idle handler)
- `androidx.profileinstaller:profileinstaller:1.4.1` -- dex2oat profile installation for startup optimization
- Baseline profile generation via macrobenchmark module

### Plugin system (unique architecture)
A multi-language plugin ecosystem:
- **Built-in plugins** (9): SponsorBlockPlugin, AdFilterPlugin, DanmakuEnhancePlugin, EyeProtectionPlugin, TodayWatchPlugin, CdnRegionPlugin, HomeFeedAnonymizerPlugin, DlnaCastPlugin, GoogleCastPlugin
- **JSON rule plugins** (`core/plugin/json/`): `JsonPluginManager`, `RuleEngine`, `JsonRulePlugin` -- declarative rule-based plugins
- **JavaScript plugins** (`core/plugin/js/`): `BiliPaiJsRuntime`, `BiliPaiJsPluginInstallStore` -- JS-based plugins with external media launch
- **Kotlin package plugins** (`core/plugin/kotlinpkg/`): `ExternalKotlinPluginPackageReader` -- compiled Kotlin plugin packages
- **Skin plugins** (`core/plugin/skin/`): `UiSkinPackageReader`, `UiSkinInstallStore` -- UI theming skins
- Plugin capabilities: PLAYER_STATE, PLAYER_CONTROL, DANMAKU_STREAM, DANMAKU_MUTATION, PLAYBACK_CDN, RECOMMENDATION_CANDIDATES, LOCAL_HISTORY_READ, LOCAL_FEEDBACK_READ, NETWORK, PLUGIN_STORAGE, EXTERNAL_MEDIA_PLAYBACK
- Plugin SDK (`:plugin-sdk` module) is separately publishable to Maven

### Download system
- `DownloadManager` (singleton) with WorkManager integration
- Resumable downloads via `ResumableAssetDownloader` with partial content range validation
- Separate audio/video download + muxing
- Offline playback via `OfflineVideoPlayerScreen`, `OfflineVideoPlaybackPolicy`, `OfflineEpisodeQueuePolicy`
- Storage access via `DocumentFile` (SAF) for user-chosen directories

### Cast/DLNA
- **Google Cast (CAF)**: `CastOptionsProvider` registered in manifest, `GoogleCastPlugin`
- **DLNA**: Custom SSDP discovery (`SsdpDiscovery` using raw `MulticastSocket`), `LocalProxyServer` (NanoHTTPD-based HTTP proxy that injects Referer/User-Agent to bypass Bilibili's anti-leech 403), `SsdpCastClient`, `DlnaCastPlugin`
- Note: Cling repo is configured in settings.gradle.kts but no Cling dependency was found in build.gradle.kts -- the DLNA implementation uses custom raw socket/multicast code instead

### Screenshots
- `feature/screenshot/` -- `AppScreenshotCaptureMode`, `AppScreenshotGestureMode` -- custom screenshot capture and gesture detection

### Other notable APIs
- `WakeLock` permission for background audio
- `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES` -- for in-app update APK installation
- `RenderEffect` / `Shader` -- used in MainActivity for blur effects
- `ComponentCallbacks2` -- PureApplication implements it for memory pressure handling (image cache trimming, player heavy optimization)
- `ProcessLifecycleOwner` (`lifecycle-process`) -- background detection via `BackgroundManager`
- `BiometricPrompt` for app lock
- `DocumentFile` (SAF) for storage access without storage permissions

261	        val plan = PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.resolveBackgroundMemoryTrimPlan(level)
262	        if (plan.imageCacheTrimLevel != null) {
263	            _imageLoader?.memoryCache?.trimMemory(plan.imageCacheTrimLevel)
264	            if (plan.requestGcHint) {
265	                System.gc()
266	            }
267	            when {
268	                plan.clearImageMemoryCache -> {
269	                    Logger.d(PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG, "🚨 trim(level=$level), released image memory cache")
270	                }
271	                level == ComponentCallbacks2.TRIM_MEMORY_UI_HIDDEN -> {
272	                    Logger.d(PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG, " UI hidden, trimmed image memory cache for background")
273	                }
274	                else -> {
275	                    Logger.d(PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG, " Low memory trim(level=$level), trimmed image memory cache")
276	                }
277	            }
278	        }
279	        if (plan.notifyPlayerHeavyOptimization) {
280	            com.android.purebilibili.feature.video.player.MiniPlayerManager
281	                .getInstanceOrNull()
282	                ?.onMemoryPressureTrim(
283	                    level = level,
284	                    requestIdlePlaybackRelease = plan.requestIdlePlaybackRelease
285	                )
286	        }
287	    }

306	    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
307	        // 仅在 Android 8.0 (API 26) 及以上需要通知渠道
308	        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
309	            val notificationManager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
310	            resolveAppNotificationChannels().forEach { spec ->
311	                val channel = NotificationChannel(spec.id, spec.name, spec.importance).apply {
312	                    description = spec.description
313	                    setShowBadge(spec.showBadge)
314	                    if (spec.silent) {
315	                        setSound(null, null)
316	                    }
317	                }
318	                notificationManager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
319	            }
320	        }
321	    }

323	    /**
324	     *  应用主题偏好 - 在 Splash Screen 显示前调用
325	     * 
326	     * 这解决了：用户在应用内强制深色模式，但系统是浅色时，启动屏仍然是白色的问题。
327	     * 通过 AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode() 强制系统使用正确的深色/浅色模式。
328	     */
329	    private fun applyThemePreference() {
330	        // 同步读取保存的主题设置（必须同步，因为 Splash Screen 马上就会显示）
331	        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("theme_cache", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
332	        val themeModeValue = prefs.getInt("theme_mode", 0)  // 0 = FOLLOW_SYSTEM
333	        val appLanguage = SettingsManager.getAppLanguageSync(this)
334	        val themeMode = resolveThemeModePreference(themeModeValue)
335	        
336	        val nightMode = when (themeMode) {
337	            AppThemeMode.FOLLOW_SYSTEM -> androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_FOLLOW_SYSTEM
338	            AppThemeMode.LIGHT -> androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_NO
339	            AppThemeMode.DARK -> androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES
340	        }
341	        
342	        applyAppLanguage(appLanguage)
343	        androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(nightMode)
344	        Logger.d(
345	            PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG,
346	            " Applied launch preferences: themeMode=$themeModeValue -> resolvedMode=$themeMode, nightMode=$nightMode, appLanguage=${appLanguage.name}"
347	        )
348	    }
349	    
350	    /**
351	     *  同步应用图标状态
352	     * 
353	     * 在 Application.onCreate 时调用，确保启动器图标与用户偏好一致。
354	     * 
355	     * 修复：重装后检测 icon 偏好与 Manifest 默认状态冲突，自动重置为默认图标。
356	     */
357	    private fun syncAppIconState() {
358	        // [Optim] Use IO dispatcher to prevent ANR during startup (PackageManager is heavy)
359	        AppScope.ioScope.launch {
360	            try {
361	                val pm = packageManager
362	                val packageName = this@PureApplication.packageName
363	                val defaultLauncherAlias = resolveAppIconLauncherAlias(packageName, "icon_3d")
364	                
365	                // 读取用户保存的图标偏好
366	                val currentIcon = normalizeAppIconKey(
367	                    SettingsManager.getAppIcon(this@PureApplication).first()
368	                )
369	                val splashIconVisible = SettingsManager.isSplashIconAnimationEnabledSync(this@PureApplication)
370	                val cacheSynced = this@PureApplication
371	                    .getSharedPreferences("app_icon_cache", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
372	                    .edit()
373	                    .putString("current_icon", currentIcon)
374	                    .commit()
375	                Logger.d(PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG, " Synced app icon cache from DataStore: $currentIcon (success=$cacheSynced)")
376	
377	                val allUniqueAliases = allManagedAppIconLauncherAliases(packageName)
378	                val targetAlias = resolveAppIconLauncherAlias(
379	                    packageName = packageName,
380	                    rawKey = currentIcon,
381	                    splashIconVisible = splashIconVisible
382	                )
383	                
384	                val targetAliasComponent = android.content.ComponentName(packageName, targetAlias)
385	                val targetState = pm.getComponentEnabledSetting(targetAliasComponent)
386	
387	                // 如果目标alias是disabled（说明之前被禁用了，可能是重装），强制重置为默认(icon_3d)
388	                if (currentIcon != "icon_3d" && targetState == android.content.pm.PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_DISABLED) {
389	                    Logger.d(PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG, " Detected reinstall: target icon '$currentIcon' is disabled, resetting to 'icon_3d'")
390	                    
391	                    SettingsManager.setAppIcon(this@PureApplication, "icon_3d")
392	                    
393	                    // 确保 3D 图标被启用
394	                    val aliasDefault = android.content.ComponentName(packageName, defaultLauncherAlias)
395	                    pm.setComponentEnabledSetting(
396	                        aliasDefault,
397	                        android.content.pm.PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_ENABLED,
398	                        android.content.pm.PackageManager.DONT_KILL_APP
399	                    )
400	                    // 禁用其他所有alias
401	                    allUniqueAliases.filter { it != defaultLauncherAlias }.forEach { aliasFullName ->
402	                        pm.setComponentEnabledSetting(
403	                            android.content.ComponentName(packageName, aliasFullName),
404	                            android.content.pm.PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_DISABLED,
405	                            android.content.pm.PackageManager.DONT_KILL_APP
406	                        )
407	                    }
408	                    Logger.d(PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG, " Reset to default 3D icon")
409	                    return@launch
410	                }
411	                
412	                // 同步所有 alias 状态：只有目标启用，其他禁用
413	                allUniqueAliases.forEach { aliasFullName ->
414	                    try {
415	                        val currentState = pm.getComponentEnabledSetting(
416	                            android.content.ComponentName(packageName, aliasFullName)
417	                        )
418	                        val shouldBeEnabled = aliasFullName == targetAlias
419	                        val targetState = if (shouldBeEnabled) {
420	                            android.content.pm.PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_ENABLED
421	                        } else {
422	                            android.content.pm.PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_DISABLED
423	                        }
424	                        
425	                        // 只在状态不一致时修改，减少不必要的操作
426	                        if (currentState != targetState) {
427	                            pm.setComponentEnabledSetting(
428	                                android.content.ComponentName(packageName, aliasFullName),
429	                                targetState,
430	                                android.content.pm.PackageManager.DONT_KILL_APP
431	                            )
432	                        }
433	                    } catch (e: Exception) {
434	                        //  [容错] 忽略不存在的组件，防止崩溃
435	                        Logger.d(PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG, "⚠️ Component $aliasFullName not found, skipping")
436	                    }
437	                }
438	                
439	                Logger.d(PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG, " Synced app icon state: $currentIcon")
440	            } catch (e: Exception) {
441	                android.util.Log.e(PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.TAG, "Failed to sync app icon state", e)
442	            }
443	        }
444	    }
445	}
446

12	internal object BiliGrpcClient {
13	    private const val APP_BASE_URL = "https://app.bilibili.com"
14	    private const val USER_AGENT =
15	        "Mozilla/5.0 BiliDroid/2.0.1 (bbcallen@gmail.com) os/android model/android_hd mobi_app/android_hd build/2001100 channel/master innerVer/2001100 osVer/15 network/2"
16	    private const val TRACE_ID = "11111111111111111111111111111111:1111111111111111:0:0"
17	    private val grpcMediaType = "application/grpc".toMediaType()
18	
19	    fun request(path: String, message: ByteArray): ByteArray {
20	        val url = "$APP_BASE_URL$path"
21	        val request = Request.Builder()
22	            .url(url)
23	            .post(ProtoWire.frame(message).toRequestBody(grpcMediaType))
24	            .header("content-type", "application/grpc")
25	            .header("grpc-encoding", "gzip")
26	            .header("gzip-accept-encoding", "gzip,identity")
27	            .header("user-agent", USER_AGENT)
28	            .header("x-bili-trace-id", TRACE_ID)
29	            .header("buvid", resolveBuvid())
30	            .header("cookie", buildCookieHeader())
31	            .apply {
32	                TokenManager.accessTokenCache
33	                    ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
34	                    ?.let { header("authorization", "identify_v1 $it") }
35	            }
36	            .build()
37	
38	        NetworkModule.okHttpClient.newCall(request).execute().use { response ->
39	            val body = response.body.bytes()
40	            val grpcStatus = response.header("grpc-status")
41	            if (!response.isSuccessful || grpcStatus != "0") {
42	                Logger.w(
43	                    "BiliGrpc",
44	                    "gRPC request failed: path=$path http=${response.code} grpc=$grpcStatus message=${response.header("grpc-message").orEmpty()}"
45	                )
46	                error("gRPC request failed: http=${response.code}, grpc=$grpcStatus")
47	            }
48	            return ProtoWire.unframe(body)
49	        }
50	    }
51	
52	    internal fun buildCookieHeader(): String {
53	        val cookies = mutableListOf("buvid3=${resolveBuvid()}")
54	        TokenManager.sessDataCache?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let {
55	            cookies += "SESSDATA=$it"
56	        }
57	        TokenManager.csrfCache?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let {
58	            cookies += "bili_jct=$it"
59	        }
60	        TokenManager.midCache?.takeIf { it > 0L }?.let {
61	            cookies += "DedeUserID=$it"
62	        }
63	        return cookies.joinToString("; ")
64	    }
65	
66	    internal fun resolveBuvid(): String {
67	        val cached = TokenManager.buvid3Cache
68	        if (!cached.isNullOrBlank()) return cached
69	        val generated = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "") + "infoc"
70	        TokenManager.buvid3Cache = generated
71	        return generated
72	    }
73	
74	    internal fun encodeBase64(bytes: ByteArray): String {
75	        return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes)
76	    }
77	}

17	/**
18	 * 运行在手机上的轻量级 HTTP 代理服务器。
19	 * 作用：拦截 DLNA/Chromecast 设备的播放请求，转发给 Bilibili 服务器并修改请求头，从而绕过防盗链 (403 Forbidden)。
20	 *
21	 * 原理：
22	 * 1. 电视/DLNA 设备请求: http://<手机IP>:<端口>/proxy?url=<编码后的B站视频URL>
23	 * 2. 代理服务器解析 `url` 参数。
24	 * 3. 代理服务器伪装成合法客户端（添加 User-Agent, Referer）向 B站请求数据。
25	 * 4. 代理服务器将 B 站返回的数据流（InputStream）直接流式传输给电视。
26	 */
27	class LocalProxyServer(port: Int = 8901) : NanoHTTPD(port) {
28	
29	    private val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
30	        .followRedirects(true)
31	        .followSslRedirects(true)
32	        .build()
33	
34	    override fun serve(session: IHTTPSession): NanoHTTPD.Response {
35	        val uri = session.uri ?: "/"
36	
37	        if (session.method == Method.OPTIONS) {
38	            val corsHeaders = corsHeaders()
39	            return newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.OK, MIME_PLAINTEXT, "").also { resp ->
40	                corsHeaders.forEach { (key, value) -> resp.addHeader(key, value) }
41	            }
42	        }
43	
44	        if (uri.startsWith("/dash/") && uri.endsWith(".mpd")) {
45	            val key = uri.removePrefix("/dash/").removeSuffix(".mpd")
46	            val manifest = manifestStore[key]
47	            if (manifest != null) {
48	                val resp = newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.OK, DASH_CONTENT_TYPE, manifest)
49	                corsHeaders().forEach { (key, value) -> resp.addHeader(key, value) }
50	                return resp
51	            }
52	            return newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND, MIME_PLAINTEXT, "Manifest not found")
53	        }
54	
55	        if (uri == "/proxy") {
56	            return serveProxy(session)
57	        }
58	
59	        return newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND, MIME_PLAINTEXT, "Not Found")
60	    }

26	    responseCode: Int,
27	    contentRange: String?,
28	    requestedStart: Long,
29	    requestedEnd: Long
30	): Boolean {
31	    if (responseCode != 206) return false
32	    val match = PARTIAL_CONTENT_RANGE_REGEX.matchEntire(contentRange?.trim().orEmpty()) ?: return false
33	    val actualStart = match.groupValues[1].toLongOrNull() ?: return false
34	    val actualEnd = match.groupValues[2].toLongOrNull() ?: return false
35	    return actualStart == requestedStart && actualEnd == requestedEnd

1	package com.android.purebilibili.app
2	
3	import android.os.Build
4	import android.os.Handler
5	import android.os.Looper
6	
7	internal class AppStartupOrchestrator(
8	    private val sdkInt: Int = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT,
9	    private val deferredDelayMs: Long = PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.deferredNonCriticalStartupDelayMs(),
10	    private val dex2OatDelayMs: Long = PureApplicationRuntimeConfig.dex2OatProfileInstallDelayMs(),
11	    private val mainHandler: Handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
12	) {
13	
14	    fun startupTasks(): List<AppStartupTask> {
15	        return defaultAppStartupTasks(
16	            sdkInt = sdkInt,
17	            deferredDelayMs = deferredDelayMs,
18	            dex2OatDelayMs = dex2OatDelayMs
19	        )
20	    }
21	
22	    fun runImmediate(taskRunner: (AppStartupTask) -> Unit) {
23	        startupTasks()
24	            .filter { it.phase == StartupPhase.BEFORE_FIRST_INTERACTIVE }
25	            .forEach(taskRunner)
26	    }
27	
28	    fun scheduleDeferred(taskRunner: (AppStartupTask) -> Unit) {
29	        val deferredTasks = startupTasks()
30	            .filter { it.phase == StartupPhase.AFTER_FIRST_INTERACTIVE }
31	
32	        val idleTasks = deferredTasks.filter { it.thread == StartupThread.MAIN_IDLE }
33	        if (idleTasks.isNotEmpty()) {
34	            Looper.myQueue().addIdleHandler {
35	                idleTasks.forEach(taskRunner)
36	                false
37	            }
38	        }
39	
40	        deferredTasks
41	            .filter { it.thread == StartupThread.MAIN_DELAYED }
42	            .forEach { task ->
43	                mainHandler.postDelayed({ taskRunner(task) }, task.delayMs)
44	            }
45	    }
46	}
47

## 总体分析

BiliPai 是一个重度原生的 Android 应用，核心能力集中在三个领域：视频播放与弹幕渲染、Bilibili API 网络层、以及高度定制的 Compose UI（含 iOS 风格组件、毛玻璃/液态玻璃效果、共享元素转场动画）。移植到 Windows 需要逐一对应这些子系统。

考虑到你已有 MoePlayer 的 WinUI 3 + C# 经验，最自然的移植路径是 **WinUI 3 / .NET 10 + C# + XAML**，下面逐层展开。

---

## 开发语言与运行时

Android 端使用 Kotlin 2.4.0 + JVM target 21。Windows 端对应选择是 **C# 13/.NET 10**（或 .NET 9 LTS）。C# 的 async/await + Task 并发模型与 Kotlin 协程 + Flow 高度对应，CommunityToolkit.Mvvm 提供 ObservableProperty、RelayCommand 等 source generator 特性，几乎可以 1:1 替换 Kotlin ViewModel + StateFlow 模式。C# 的 record 和 pattern matching 也能对应 Kotlin 的 data class 和 when 表达式。

如果需要跨平台（未来支持 macOS/Linux），备选方案是 **Avalonia UI 11 + C#**，它的 XAML 语法和 WinUI 类似，但 API 设计更接近 WPF。不过 Avalonia 在媒体渲染和原生窗口管理方面不如 WinUI 3 成熟，对于弹幕叠加、视频窗口分层这类需求会多一层抽象开销。

---

## UI 框架与组件映射

BiliPai 的 UI 层是最复杂的部分，涉及多个第三方库：

Jetpack Compose → **WinUI 3 (Windows App SDK 1.6+)**。WinUI 3 的 XAML 是声明式的，虽然不像 Compose 那样完全用代码写 UI，但通过 code-behind + XAML 的组合可以实现等效的动态 UI。CommunityToolkit 提供了 ` AttachedCard.HoverShadow` 等扩展，你已在 MoePlayer 中验证了这条路径。

Material 3 → **Fluent Design System**。WinUI 3 原生提供 Acrylic（毛玻璃）、Mica（背景拟态）、Reveal（揭示高光）等材质，可以替代 Haze 和 Miuix Blur。对于更精细的模糊控制（类似 BlurBudgetPolicy、BlurIntensityVisualPolicy），可以使用 `Microsoft.UI.Composition` 的 CompositionEffectBrush 直接控制高斯模糊半径和不透明度。

iOS 风格组件（Cupertino 库，含 SF Symbols 800+ 图标、连续圆角 Squircle）→ 需要手动实现。WinUI 的 `CornerRadius` 不是连续圆角，如果要还原 iOS 观感，需要用 `Win2D` 或 `Microsoft.UI.Xaml` 的 `Path` 控件绘制超椭圆（superellipse）路径。图标方面可用 `Segoe Fluent Icons`（6,000+ 图标）替代 SF Symbols，或内嵌 Cupertino 图标字体。

Lottie 动画 → **Microsoft.UI.Xaml.LottieAnimation** 或 SkiaSharp 的 Lottie 支持。WinUI 的 Lottie 实现基于 Windows.UI.Composition，性能接近原生。

骨架屏（Shimmer）→ 可用 Composition 的 ScalarKeyFrameAnimation 实现等效的光泽扫过动画。

液态玻璃/透镜折射（Backdrop 库）→ 这是最难直接替代的效果。WinUI 的 Acrylic 只提供背景模糊，不含透镜折射和高光反射。要还原 visionOS 风格的液态玻璃效果，需要用 Direct2D + 自定义 Pixel Shader（HLSL）实现折射 + 高光 + 边缘连续圆角的组合效果。

---

## 视频播放器

ExoPlayer (Media3 1.10.0) → **libmpv**（通过 mpv.net 或直接 P/Invoke libmpv.dll）。这与你的 MoePlayer 方案完全一致，可以复用已有经验。mpv 原生支持 DASH（Bilibili 的分离音视频流）、HLS 直播、硬解、字幕、音轨切换、播放速度控制等全部功能。

BiliPai 使用 MergingMediaSource 将 DASH 分离的音频和视频流合并播放——mpv 的 `--audio-file` 参数可以直接加载外部音轨，等效实现。

MediaSession（系统媒体控制）→ Windows 端对应 **SystemMediaTransportControls (SMTC)**。WinUI 应用可以通过 `Windows.Media.Playback` 命名空间接入 SMTC，实现系统级媒体键控制、锁屏播放控制。前台服务（background playback）在 Windows 上不需要特殊处理——Windows 应用默认可以在后台运行，只需注册 SMTC 即可维持音频播放。

PIP（画中画）→ **Windows CompactOverlay 模式**。通过 `ApplicationView.TryEnterViewModeAsync(ViewModePreference.CompactOverlay)` 进入画中画，比 Android 的 PIP API 更灵活（可以调整窗口大小）。

SponsorBlock 段落跳过逻辑（BasePlayerViewModel 中的 segment loading + skip timing）可以直接照搬到 C# ViewModel 中，绑定 mpv 的时间变化事件。

---

## 弹幕渲染引擎

ByteDance DanmakuRenderEngine → 没有现成的 Windows 弹幕库，需要**自行实现**。推荐方案：

使用 WinUI 3 的 `Microsoft.Graphics.Canvas`（Win2D）作为渲染后端。Win2D 基于 Direct2D/Direct3D 11，提供高性能的 Canvas 绘图 API。弹幕渲染架构设计如下：滚动弹幕用 Canvas 的 DrawText + 逐帧位移实现，定弹幕（顶部/底部）用固定坐标 DrawText。弹幕生命周期管理（碰撞检测、轨道分配、淡入淡出）可以封装为 C# 的 DanmakuManager 类，对应原项目的 DanmakuManager + DanmakuParser + DanmakuConfig。

弹幕协议解析（protobuf + Brotli 压缩）→ 用 `Google.Protobuf` 库做 protobuf 反序列化，`System.IO.Compression.BrotliStream` 做解压。Bilibili 弹幕的 XML/JSON 格式可以直接用 `System.Xml.Linq` 或 `System.Text.Json` 解析。

直播弹幕 WebSocket 协议 → 用 `System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket` 替代 OkHttp WebSocket。协议解析逻辑（认证、心跳、binary frame 解析）可以直接从 Kotlin 移植到 C#。

---

## 网络层

Retrofit + OkHttp → **Refit + HttpClient**。Refit 是 .NET 的声明式 HTTP 客户端库，用 interface + attribute 定义 API 端点，与 Retrofit 的用法几乎一模一样。HttpClient 由 `IHttpClientFactory` 管理生命周期。

kotlinx-serialization → **System.Text.Json**（内置）或 **Utf8Json**（更高性能）。DTO 类用 C# record 或 class + JsonPropertyName attribute 定义。

WBI 签名、App 签名、Token 刷新等业务逻辑都是纯计算，可以直接从 Kotlin 翻译到 C#，不依赖任何特定库。AppSessionCookieJar（内存 Cookie 管理）用 `System.Net.CookieContainer` 实现。

自定义 DNS + IP 回退 → HttpClient 的 `SocketsHttpHandler` 支持自定义 DNS 解析器，可以注入自定义 IP 列表做 fallback。

gRPC-over-HTTP（BiliGrpcClient 手动实现 ProtoWire 帧）→ 这段逻辑是纯二进制读写，C# 的 `Span<byte>` + `BinaryReader/Writer` 可以高效实现。如果未来想用标准 gRPC 工具链，可以引入 `Grpc.Net.Client`。

Brotli 解压 → `System.IO.Compression.BrotliStream`（.NET 内置）。

本地 HTTP 代理服务器（NanoHTTPD，用于 DLNA 投屏时注入 Referer 绕过防盗链）→ 用 **ASP.NET Core Kestrel** 做轻量 HTTP 服务器，或者用 `HttpListener` 做最小化实现。

---

## 数据持久化

Room（SQLite ORM）→ **Entity Framework Core** + SQLite provider（`Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite`）。EF Core 的 DbContext + DbSet 对应 Room 的 Database + DAO，LINQ 查询替代 Room 的 @Query。Code-first migration 对应 Room 的 Migration。

DataStore（异步偏好设置）→ **Windows.Storage.ApplicationData.Current.LocalSettings**（原生设置存储）或封装一个基于 JSON 文件的 `SettingsService`。如果想要类似 DataStore 的异步偏好存储，可以用 `Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration` + JSON 文件实现。

SharedPreferences（同步读取）→ `ApplicationData.Current.LocalSettings` 支持同步访问，适合启动时的快速配置读取。

---

## 导航系统

Navigation3（类型安全 Compose 导航）→ WinUI 3 没有内置的强类型导航框架，但可以用 **CommunityToolkit.Mvvm 的 Frame 导航 + 自定义 NavKey 系统** 实现等效功能。定义一个 record 类型作为路由 key，用 `Frame.Navigate` 配合 parameter 传递。共享元素转场动画需要用 `ConnectedAnimation` API 实现——WinUI 原生支持 `ConnectedAnimationService`，可以做出从列表卡片到详情页的连续过渡效果。

预测性返回（predictive back）→ Windows 11 的 `AppWindow` 支持 `Closing` 事件和 `BackRequested` 事件，可以接入手势返回逻辑。

---

## 依赖注入

原项目没有使用 DI 框架（纯单例 object 模式）。Windows 端可以用 **Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection** 做轻量 DI，或者保持单例模式（C# 的 `static` 类或 `Lazy<T>` 单例）。推荐引入 DI 容器，因为 WinUI 3 的 Page/ViewModel 生命周期管理比 Android 更需要它。

---

## 插件系统

这是架构上最有挑战的部分。原项目支持四种插件：内置 Kotlin 插件、JSON 规则插件、JavaScript 插件、外部 Kotlin 包。

Windows 端的对应方案：

内置插件 → 直接用 C# 接口 + 内置实现，最简单。JSON 规则插件 → `System.Text.Json` 解析规则 + C# 规则引擎，逻辑直接移植。JavaScript 插件 → **Jint**（纯 .NET 的 JavaScript 解释器）或 **ClearScript**（V8 引擎绑定）。Jint 更轻量，适合简单的规则脚本；ClearScript 性能更好，适合复杂逻辑。外部编译插件 → .NET 的 `AssemblyLoadContext` 支持动态加载编译后的 DLL，可以实现类似的外部插件包功能。Plugin SDK（当前是 Kotlin publishable module）→ 对应为 NuGet 包，用 `dotnet pack` 发布。

---

## DLNA / Google Cast

DLNA（自定义 SSDP 发现 + NanoHTTPD 代理）→ SSDP 多播发现用 `System.Net.Sockets.UdpClient` 的 `JoinMulticastGroup` 实现，与原项目的 `MulticastSocket` 逻辑一致。DLNA 设备控制（SOAP 请求）用 HttpClient 发送即可。本地代理服务器用 Kestrel 或 HttpListener。

Google Cast（CAF SDK）→ Windows 上没有官方 Cast SDK。备选方案是用 **GNCast** 或自行实现 CASTv2 协议（基于 Protobuf over TLS）。这部分移植优先级最低，建议后期处理。

---

## 其他原生 API 映射

生物认证（BiometricPrompt）→ **Windows Hello**。用 `Windows.Security.Credentials` 的 `KeyCredentialManager` 或 `Windows.Security.Cryptography` 的生物认证 API。前台服务/后台下载 → Windows 不需要前台服务概念。后台下载用 **BackgroundTransfer API** 或 `Windows.Networking.BackgroundTransfer`，也可直接在应用内用 HttpClient 做异步下载。WakeLock → `Windows.System.PowerManager.RequestDischargePowerSave`（防止屏幕关闭）。应用图标切换 → Windows 不支持动态图标，只能通过 `AppListEntry` 的 Logo 属性切换，但限制较大。Firebase Crashlytics → **AppCenter** 或 **Sentry**。Lottie → Windows Lottie。

---

## 推荐技术栈总览

## 移植风险与重点

最需要投入精力的三个领域：

第一是弹幕渲染引擎，需要从零实现一套高性能的 Win2D 弹幕渲染管线，包括轨道分配、碰撞检测、滚动/定弹幕混合渲染、字幕叠加。原项目的 ByteDance 引擎是闭源的，无法直接参考其实现细节，只能按效果复现。

第二是液态玻璃视觉效果，原项目用了 Backdrop（透镜折射）、Haze（毛玻璃）、Cupertino（iOS 控件）三套库叠加。WinUI 的 Acrylic 只能覆盖基础毛玻璃需求，折射和高光效果需要写自定义 HLSL shader，工作量不小。

第三是视频窗口与 UI 层的 z-order 管理。你已在 MoePlayer 中处理过 video HWND 和 overlay HWND 的分层问题，BiliPai 移植会面临同样的挑战——弹幕层、字幕层、播放器控制层、手势遮罩层需要精确的窗口分层或在同一 SwapChainPanel 上的精确渲染顺序管理。

网络层、数据模型、业务逻辑（Repository/UseCase/Policy）这些部分是纯 Kotlin 到 C# 的语言级翻译，不涉及平台差异，是最顺利的部分。

# BiliPai C#/.NET Portability Analysis (54 Files Examined)

## Executive Summary

A very substantial portion of BiliPai's business logic is **pure Kotlin** with no Android dependencies. The project follows a well-structured architecture where policy/decision functions are separated from infrastructure. Roughly **65-70% of the code examined is directly portable** to C#/.NET with only mechanical translation changes (kotlinx.serialization annotations to System.Text.Json, Kotlin coroutines to C# async/await, etc.). The main non-portable areas are: Android UI/Compose rendering, Android DataStore/SharedPreferences persistence, Android WebView-based JS runtime, and Android connectivity/network APIs.

---

## 3. Network Layer -- SPLIT: Pure Crypto/Protocol vs Android Infrastructure

### Directly Portable (Pure Kotlin/Java)

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\WbiUtils.kt`**
- Imports: `java.net.URLEncoder`, `java.security.MessageDigest` -- pure Java SE
- Pure: WBI signature calculation (mixin key extraction, MD5, URL encoding, risk fingerprint params)
- Porting: `URLEncoder` -> `System.Web.HttpUtility.UrlEncode`, `MessageDigest` -> `System.Security.Cryptography.MD5`. The `Logger.d()` call can be replaced with any logger.

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\AppSignUtils.kt`**
- Imports: `java.net.URLEncoder`, `java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets`, `java.security.MessageDigest`
- Pure: APP signature calculation (MD5-based), TV/Android/HD appkey constants, session ID generation
- Porting: Same as WbiUtils -- replace MD5/URLEncoder with .NET equivalents

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\grpc\ProtoWire.kt`**
- Imports: `java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream`, `java.nio.ByteBuffer`, `java.nio.ByteOrder`, `java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream/GZIPOutputStream` -- all pure Java SE
- Pure: Hand-rolled protobuf wire format codec (varint, field, int64, string, bool, double, parseFields) + gRPC framing/unframing + CESU-8/UTF-8 tolerant decoder
- Porting: `ByteBuffer` -> `BinaryPrimitives`/`MemoryStream`, GZIP -> `System.IO.Compression.GZipStream`. This is 100% portable with mechanical changes.

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\socket\DanmakuProtocol.kt`**
- Imports: `kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers`, `org.brotli.dec.BrotliInputStream`, `java.io.*`, `java.nio.ByteBuffer`
- Pure: Live danmaku binary protocol codec (encode/decode packets, Zlib/Brotli decompression with recursive parsing)
- Porting: `ByteBuffer` -> `BinaryReader`/`MemoryStream`, `BrotliInputStream` -> `BrotliDecoder` (available in .NET 6+ via `System.IO.Compression.BrotliDecoder`). The `Dispatchers.Default` coroutine context maps to `Task.Run`.

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\network-core\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\policy\NetworkFallbackPolicy.kt`**
- Imports: None
- Pure: DNS fallback data + certificate trust policy functions
- Porting: Trivial

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\network-core\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\policy\HomeFeedAnonymizerPolicy.kt`**
- Imports: None
- Pure: Cookie anonymizer logic, stats tracking
- Porting: Trivial

### Android-Dependent (Need Rewriting)

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\WbiKeyManager.kt`**
- Android imports: `android.content.Context`, `android.util.Log`
- Uses `SharedPreferences` for persistence. The in-memory cache + mutex + refresh logic is portable, but `persistToStorage`/`restoreFromStorage` use Android SharedPreferences and need rewriting to a .NET key-value store.

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\ApiClient.kt`**
- Android imports: `android.content.Context`, `com.android.purebilibili.BuildConfig`
- Uses OkHttp/Retrofit. The `BilibiliApi` interface (Retrofit annotations) defines API contracts that are portable in concept but need rewriting to .NET HTTP client patterns. The `AppSessionCookieJar` is OkHttp-specific.

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\TokenRefreshHelper.kt`**
- Android imports: `android.content.Context`
- Depends on `TokenManager` (Android DataStore). Logic is portable but infrastructure needs swapping.

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\grpc\BiliGrpcClient.kt`**
- Uses OkHttp (`okhttp3.*`), depends on `NetworkModule`, `TokenManager`. The cookie/auth header building logic (`buildCookieHeader`, `resolveBuvid`) is pure. Needs HttpClient swap.

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\core\network\socket\LiveDanmakuClient.kt`**
- Android imports: `android.os.SystemClock`, `android.util.Log`
- Uses OkHttp WebSocket. Core logic (reconnect with exponential backoff, heartbeat, auth, message flow) is portable but needs a C# WebSocket client (e.g., `System.Net.WebSockets.ClientWebSocket`).

### Directly Portable (Pure Data Transformation)

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\feature\video\danmaku\DanmakuProto.kt`**
- Imports: `android.util.Log` (replaceable), `java.io.ByteArrayInputStream`, `java.io.DataInputStream`, `java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets`
- Pure: Complete hand-rolled protobuf parser for danmaku segments, DmWebViewReply, CommandDm, DmSetting. Includes a self-contained `ProtoInput` class for varint/bytes/string/float reading.
- Porting: Remove `Log` calls (or replace with console). The `ProtoInput` class translates directly to C# with `byte[]` and index arithmetic.

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\feature\video\danmaku\CommandDanmakuPolicy.kt`**
- Imports: `org.json.JSONObject` (Java SE)
- Pure: `CommandDanmakuType` enum, `CommandDanmakuItem` data class, 6+ functions for building/filtering command danmaku. Includes regex-based JSON field extraction.
- Porting: `org.json.JSONObject` -> `System.Text.Json.JsonDocument` or `JsonNode`

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\feature\video\danmaku\DanmakuTypeFilterPolicy.kt`**
- Imports: None
- Pure: `DanmakuTypeFilterSettings` data class + functions for type/color filtering
- Porting: Trivial

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\feature\video\danmaku\DanmakuKeywordFilterPolicy.kt`**
- Imports: `kotlinx.serialization.json.*` only
- Pure: Full danmaku block rule system -- parsing (JSON/text), compilation to matchers (keyword/regex/userHash), partition, merge, append. Sealed interface `DanmakuBlockRuleMatcher` with 3 implementations.
- Porting: `kotlinx.serialization.json` -> `System.Text.Json`. Regex API is similar between Kotlin and C#.

### Android-Dependent (Rendering Engine Coupled)

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\feature\video\danmaku\DanmakuParser.kt`**
- Android imports: `android.util.Log`, `android.util.Xml`, `com.bytedance.danmaku.render.engine.*` (DanmakuData, TextData, layer types)
- The protobuf parsing calls `DanmakuProto.parse()` (portable), but output is `DanmakuData`/`TextData` from ByteDance engine. The XML parsing uses `android.util.Xml`.
- Porting: Would need to define own `DanmakuData`/`TextData` equivalents and use `System.Xml.XmlReader` for XML.

**`D:\Documents\GitHub\BiliPai\app\src\main\java\com\android\purebilibili\feature\video\danmaku\DanmakuMerger.kt`**
- Imports: `com.bytedance.danmaku.render.engine.data.DanmakuData`, `com.bytedance.danmaku.render.engine.render.draw.text.TextData`, `android.util.Log`
- The merge algorithm (group by content, time-cluster, combine batches) is pure logic, but operates on ByteDance types. Would need own danmaku data types.

## Key Porting Changes Required (for portable files)

1. **kotlinx.serialization** -> **System.Text.Json**: Replace `@Serializable` with `[Serializable]`, `@SerialName("x")` with `[JsonPropertyName("x")]`, custom `KSerializer` with `JsonConverter<T>`
2. **Kotlin coroutines** -> **C# async/await**: `suspend fun` -> `async Task<T>`, `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)` -> `Task.Run`, `delay()` -> `Task.Delay()`
3. **java.security.MessageDigest** -> **System.Security.Cryptography.MD5.HashData()**
4. **java.net.URLEncoder** -> **System.Web.HttpUtility.UrlEncode()** or **Uri.EscapeDataString()**
5. **java.nio.ByteBuffer** -> **BinaryReader/BinaryWriter** or **MemoryStream** with `BinaryPrimitives**
6. **java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream** -> **System.IO.Compression.GZipStream**
7. **org.brotli.dec.BrotliInputStream** -> **System.IO.Compression.BrotliStream** (.NET 6+)
8. **Kotlin Regex** -> **System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex** (nearly identical API)
9. **Kotlin data class** -> **C# record** or **class with init properties**
10. **Kotlin sealed class** -> **C# abstract base class** or **discriminated unions** (pattern matching)

74	        val sortedKeys = rawParams.keys.sorted()

76	        // 3. 拼接字符串用于计算 Hash (Key=EncodedValue)
77	        val queryBuilder = StringBuilder()
78	        for (key in sortedKeys) {
79	            val value = rawParams[key]
80	            if (value != null) {
81	                // 重点：这里编码只是为了算 Hash
82	                val encodedValue = encodeURIComponent(value)
83	
84	                if (queryBuilder.isNotEmpty()) {
85	                    queryBuilder.append("&")
86	                }
87	                queryBuilder.append(key).append("=").append(encodedValue)
88	            }
89	        }
90	
91	        // 4. 计算签名
92	        val strToHash = queryBuilder.toString() + mixinKey
93	        val wRid = md5(strToHash)
94	        
95	        com.android.purebilibili.core.util.Logger.d("WbiUtils", " w_rid: $wRid, params count: ${rawParams.size}")
96	
97	        // 5. 将签名加入原始参数表
98	        rawParams["w_rid"] = wRid
99	
100	        // 返回未编码的 Map，交给 Retrofit 处理
101	        return rawParams
102	    }
103	}
104	
```

54	            val rechecked = cachedKeys
55	            if (rechecked != null && isCacheValid()) {

8	/**
9	 *  APP 签名工具类

11	 * 
12	 * 参考: https://github.com/SocialSisterYi/bilibili-API-collect/blob/master/docs/misc/sign/APPKey.md
13	 */
14	object AppSignUtils {
15	    
16	    //  TV 端 appkey 和 appsec (云视听小电视)
17	    // 注意：通过某一组 APPKEY/APPSEC 获取到的 access_token，之后的 API 调用也必须使用同一组
18	    const val TV_APP_KEY = "4409e2ce8ffd12b8"
19	    private const val TV_APP_SEC = "59b43e04ad6965f34319062b478f83dd"
20	    
21	    //  Android 客户端 appkey 和 appsec (用于获取高画质视频)
22	    const val ANDROID_APP_KEY = "1d8b6e7d45233436"
23	    private const val ANDROID_APP_SEC = "560c52ccd288fed045859ed18bffd973"
24	
25	    // Bilibili HD client credentials used by the current SMS login endpoints.
26	    const val ANDROID_HD_APP_KEY = "dfca71928277209b"
27	    private const val ANDROID_HD_APP_SEC = "b5475a8825547a4fc26c7d518eaaa02e"
28	    
29	    /**
30	     * Percent-encode like Dart/PiliPlus Uri.encodeComponent / encodeURIComponent.
31	     * Uses URLEncoder then maps '+' to '%20' so spaces match form-urlencoded clients
32	     * that do not use application/x-www-form-urlencoded's plus convention.
33	     */
34	    fun percentEncode(value: String): String {
35	        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name()).replace("+", "%20")
36	    }
37	
38	    /**
39	     * 计算 APP 签名
40	     * 签名规则：将参数按 key 排序后拼接成 query string，末尾加上 appsec，然后 MD5
41	     * 
42	     * @param params 请求参数 (不含 sign)
43	     * @param appSec 使用的 appsec
44	     * @return 签名后的完整参数 Map (含 sign)
45	     */
46	    fun sign(params: Map<String, String>, appSec: String = TV_APP_SEC): Map<String, String> {
47	        val sortedParams = params.toSortedMap()
48	        
49	        // 构建 query string
50	        val queryString = sortedParams.entries.joinToString("&") { "${it.key}=${it.value}" }
51	        
52	        // 计算 MD5
53	        val signStr = queryString + appSec
54	        val sign = md5(signStr)
55	        
56	        // 返回包含 sign 的完整参数
57	        return sortedParams + ("sign" to sign)
58	    }
59	    
60	    /**
61	     * 为 TV 端登录生成签名
62	     */
63	    fun signForTvLogin(params: Map<String, String>): Map<String, String> {
64	        return sign(params, TV_APP_SEC)
65	    }
66	    
67	    /**
68	     * 为 Android APP API 生成签名 (用于 playurl 等)
69	     */
70	    fun signForAndroidApi(params: Map<String, String>): Map<String, String> {
71	        return sign(params, ANDROID_APP_SEC)
72	    }
73	
74	    /**
75	     * HD 登录签名：与 bilibili-API-collect Java demo / PiliPlus AppSign 一致，
76	     * 对 key/value 做 percent-encode 后再 MD5(query + appsec)。
77	     */
78	    fun signForAndroidHdLogin(params: Map<String, String>): Map<String, String> {
79	        val withAppKey = if (params.containsKey("appkey")) {
80	            params
81	        } else {
82	            params + ("appkey" to ANDROID_HD_APP_KEY)
83	        }
84	        val sortedParams = withAppKey.toSortedMap()
85	        val queryString = sortedParams.entries.joinToString("&") { (key, value) ->
86	            "${percentEncode(key)}=${percentEncode(value)}"
87	        }
88	        return sortedParams + ("sign" to md5(queryString + ANDROID_HD_APP_SEC))
89	    }
90	
91	    fun createLoginSessionId(buvid: String, timestampMillis: Long): String {
92	        return md5(buvid + timestampMillis)
93	    }
94	    
95	    /**
96	     * 获取当前时间戳 (秒)
97	     */
98	    fun getTimestamp(): Long = System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000
99	    
100	    /**
101	     * MD5 计算
102	     */
103	    private fun md5(input: String): String {
104	        val md = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5")
105	        val digest = md.digest(input.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
106	        return digest.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
107	    }
108	}

13	object TokenRefreshHelper {
14	    private const val TAG = "TokenRefreshHelper"
15	    private val mutex = Mutex()
16	    
17	    /**
18	     * 尝试刷新 Token
19	     * 如果刷新成功，会自动更新 TokenManager 中的缓存
20	     * 
21	     * @return true if refresh success, false otherwise
22	     */
23	    suspend fun refresh(context: Context): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
24	        try {
25	            if (TokenManager.accessTokenPlatformCache != TokenManager.ACCESS_TOKEN_PLATFORM_TV) {
26	                Logger.d(TAG, "Refresh is unavailable for this token platform")
27	                return false
28	            }
29	            val refreshToken = TokenManager.refreshTokenCache
30	            if (refreshToken.isNullOrEmpty()) {
31	                Logger.d(TAG, "Refresh failed: No refresh_token available")
32	                return false
33	            }
34	            
35	            Logger.d(TAG, "Starting token refresh...")
36	            
37	            val params = mapOf(
38	                "access_key" to (TokenManager.accessTokenCache ?: ""),
39	                "refresh_token" to refreshToken,
40	                "appkey" to AppSignUtils.TV_APP_KEY,
41	                "ts" to AppSignUtils.getTimestamp().toString()
42	            )
43	            
44	            val signedParams = AppSignUtils.signForTvLogin(params)
45	            
46	            val response = NetworkModule.passportApi.refreshToken(signedParams)
47	            
48	            if (response.code == 0 && response.data != null) {
49	                val data = response.data
50	                Logger.d(TAG, "Token refresh success!")
51	                
52	                // 更新 Token
53	                TokenManager.saveAccessToken(
54	                    context, 
55	                    data.accessToken, 
56	                    data.refreshToken
57	                )
58	                
59	                // 更新 Cookies (如果有)
60	                data.cookieInfo?.cookies?.forEach { cookie ->
61	                     if (cookie.name == "SESSDATA") {
62	                         TokenManager.saveCookies(context, cookie.value)
63	                     } else if (cookie.name == "bili_jct") {
64	                         TokenManager.saveCsrf(context, cookie.value)
65	                     }
66	                }
67	                
68	                return true
69	            } else {
70	                Logger.e(TAG, "Token refresh failed: code=${response.code}, msg=${response.message}")
71	                return false
72	            }
73	        } catch (e: Exception) {
74	            Logger.e(TAG, "Token refresh exception", e)
75	            return false
76	        }
77	    }

24	    fun frame(message: ByteArray, gzipMinLength: Int = 64): ByteArray {

27	        return ByteArrayOutputStream(payload.size + 5).use { out ->
28	            out.write(if (compressed) 1 else 0)

168	                val codePoint = ((first and 0x1F) shl 6) or (bytes[index + 1].unsigned() and 0x3F)

201	            out.append(REPLACEMENT_CHAR)

204	        }

210	        if (bytes[index].unsigned() != 0xED) return null
211	        val codePoint = decodeThreeByteCodePoint(bytes, index)
212	        return codePoint.takeIf { it in LOW_SURROGATE_START..LOW_SURROGATE_END }

215	    private fun hasContinuation(bytes: ByteArray, index: Int, count: Int): Boolean {
216	        if (index + count >= bytes.size) return false
217	        for (offset in 1..count) {

237	            0xF4 -> second <= 0x8F

245	            (bytes[index + 2].unsigned() and 0x3F)

250	            ((bytes[index + 1].unsigned() and 0x3F) shl 12) or
251	            ((bytes[index + 2].unsigned() and 0x3F) shl 6) or
252	            (bytes[index + 3].unsigned() and 0x3F)

268	        fun exhausted(): Boolean = position >= data.size
269	
270	        fun readVarint(): Long {
271	            var shift = 0
272	            var result = 0L
273	            while (shift < 64) {
274	                val byte = readByte().toLong() and 0xFF
275	                result = result or ((byte and 0x7F) shl shift)
276	                if ((byte and 0x80) == 0L) return result
277	                shift += 7
278	            }
279	            error("Malformed protobuf varint")
280	        }

283	            require(position + 8 <= data.size) { "Unexpected EOF reading fixed64" }
284	            val value = ByteBuffer.wrap(data, position, 8).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).long
285	            position += 8
286	            return value
287	        }
288

290	            require(position + 4 <= data.size) { "Unexpected EOF reading fixed32" }
291	            val value = ByteBuffer.wrap(data, position, 4).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).int
292	            position += 4
293	            return value
294	        }

297	            require(length >= 0 && position + length <= data.size) { "Unexpected EOF reading bytes: $length" }

12	internal object BiliGrpcClient {
13	    private const val APP_BASE_URL = "https://app.bilibili.com"
14	    private const val USER_AGENT =
15	        "Mozilla/5.0 BiliDroid/2.0.1 (bbcallen@gmail.com) os/android model/android_hd mobi_app/android_hd build/2001100 channel/master innerVer/2001100 osVer/15 network/2"
16	    private const val TRACE_ID = "11111111111111111111111111111111:1111111111111111:0:0"
17	    private val grpcMediaType = "application/grpc".toMediaType()
18	
19	    fun request(path: String, message: ByteArray): ByteArray {
20	        val url = "$APP_BASE_URL$path"
21	        val request = Request.Builder()
22	            .url(url)
23	            .post(ProtoWire.frame(message).toRequestBody(grpcMediaType))
24	            .header("content-type", "application/grpc")
25	            .header("grpc-encoding", "gzip")
26	            .header("gzip-accept-encoding", "gzip,identity")
27	            .header("user-agent", USER_AGENT)
28	            .header("x-bili-trace-id", TRACE_ID)
29	            .header("buvid", resolveBuvid())
30	            .header("cookie", buildCookieHeader())
31	            .apply {
32	                TokenManager.accessTokenCache
33	                    ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
34	                    ?.let { header("authorization", "identify_v1 $it") }
35	            }
36	            .build()
37	
38	        NetworkModule.okHttpClient.newCall(request).execute().use { response ->
39	            val body = response.body.bytes()
40	            val grpcStatus = response.header("grpc-status")
41	            if (!response.isSuccessful || grpcStatus != "0") {
42	                Logger.w(
43	                    "BiliGrpc",
44	                    "gRPC request failed: path=$path http=${response.code} grpc=$grpcStatus message=${response.header("grpc-message").orEmpty()}"
45	                )
46	                error("gRPC request failed: http=${response.code}, grpc=$grpcStatus")
47	            }
48	            return ProtoWire.unframe(body)
49	        }
50	    }
51	
52	    internal fun buildCookieHeader(): String {
53	        val cookies = mutableListOf("buvid3=${resolveBuvid()}")
54	        TokenManager.sessDataCache?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let {
55	            cookies += "SESSDATA=$it"
56	        }
57	        TokenManager.csrfCache?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let {
58	            cookies += "bili_jct=$it"
59	        }
60	        TokenManager.midCache?.takeIf { it > 0L }?.let {
61	            cookies += "DedeUserID=$it"
62	        }
63	        return cookies.joinToString("; ")
64	    }
65	
66	    internal fun resolveBuvid(): String {
67	        val cached = TokenManager.buvid3Cache
68	        if (!cached.isNullOrBlank()) return cached
69	        val generated = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "") + "infoc"
70	        TokenManager.buvid3Cache = generated
71	        return generated
72	    }

12	/**
13	 * Bilibili 直播弹幕协议解析器
14	 * 
15	 * 协议格式 (Big Endian):
16	 * [0-3]   Packet Length (Header + Body)
17	 * [4-5]   Header Length (16)
18	 * [6-7]   Protocol Version
19	 * [8-11]  Operation
20	 * [12-15] Sequence ID
21	 * [16-..] Body
22	 */
23	object DanmakuProtocol {
24	    // 头部长度
25	    const val HEAD_LENGTH = 16
26	    
27	    // 协议版本
28	    const val PROTO_VER_JSON = 0       // JSON 数据
29	    const val PROTO_VER_HEARTBEAT = 1  // 心跳/人气值 (Int32)
30	    const val PROTO_VER_ZLIB = 2       // Zlib 压缩
31	    const val PROTO_VER_BROTLI = 3     // Brotli 压缩 (目前主流)
32	    
33	    // 操作码
34	    const val OP_HEARTBEAT = 2         // 客户端发送心跳
35	    const val OP_HEARTBEAT_REPLY = 3   // 服务端回复心跳 (人气值)
36	    const val OP_MESSAGE = 5           // 通知消息 (弹幕、礼物等)
37	    const val OP_AUTH = 7              // 认证包
38	    const val OP_AUTH_REPLY = 8        // 认证响应
39	    
40	    /**
41	     * 数据包结构
42	     */
43	    data class Packet(
44	        val version: Int,
45	        val operation: Int,
46	        val sequence: Int = 1,
47	        val body: ByteArray
48	    ) {
49	        override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
50	            if (this === other) return true
51	            if (javaClass != other?.javaClass) return false
52	            other as Packet
53	            if (version != other.version) return false
54	            if (operation != other.operation) return false
55	            if (sequence != other.sequence) return false
56	            if (!body.contentEquals(other.body)) return false
57	            return true
58	        }
59	
60	        override fun hashCode(): Int {
61	            var result = version
62	            result = 31 * result + operation
63	            result = 31 * result + sequence
64	            result = 31 * result + body.contentHashCode()
65	            return result
66	        }
67	    }
68	
69	    /**
70	     * 编码数据包 (Client -> Server)
71	     */
72	    fun encode(packet: Packet): ByteArray {
73	        val totalLength = HEAD_LENGTH + packet.body.size
74	        val buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(totalLength).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN)
75	        
76	        buffer.putInt(totalLength)      // Packet Length
77	        buffer.putShort(HEAD_LENGTH.toShort()) // Header Length
78	        buffer.putShort(packet.version.toShort()) // Protocol Version
79	        buffer.putInt(packet.operation) // Operation
80	        buffer.putInt(packet.sequence)  // Sequence ID
81	        
82	        if (packet.body.isNotEmpty()) {
83	            buffer.put(packet.body)
84	        }
85	        
86	        return buffer.array()
87	    }
88	    
89	    /**
90	     * 解码数据包 (Server -> Client)
91	     * 支持递归解压 (Brotli/Zlib)
92	     */
93	    suspend fun decode(data: ByteArray): List<Packet> = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
94	        if (data.size < HEAD_LENGTH) return@withContext emptyList()
95	        
96	        val packets = mutableListOf<Packet>()
97	        val buffer = ByteBuffer.wrap(data).order(ByteOrder.BIG_ENDIAN)
98	        
99	        while (buffer.remaining() >= HEAD_LENGTH) {
100	            val position = buffer.position()
101	            val totalLength = buffer.int
102	            
103	            // 校验包长度是否合法
104	            if (totalLength < HEAD_LENGTH || totalLength > buffer.capacity() - position) {
105	                // 数据不完整或错误，停止解析
106	                break
107	            }
108	            
109	            val headLength = buffer.short.toInt()
110	            val version = buffer.short.toInt()
111	            val operation = buffer.int
112	            val sequence = buffer.int
113	
114	            if (headLength < HEAD_LENGTH || headLength > totalLength) {
115	                break
116	            }
117	            
118	            val bodyLength = totalLength - headLength
119	            if (bodyLength < 0 || bodyLength > buffer.remaining()) {
120	                break
121	            }
122	            val body = ByteArray(bodyLength)
123	            buffer.get(body)
124	            
125	            when (version) {
126	                PROTO_VER_JSON, PROTO_VER_HEARTBEAT -> {
127	                    // 普通数据，直接添加
128	                    packets.add(Packet(version, operation, sequence, body))
129	                }
130	                PROTO_VER_ZLIB -> {
131	                    // Zlib 解压后递归解析
132	                    try {
133	                        val decompressed = decompressZlib(body)
134	                        packets.addAll(decode(decompressed))
135	                    } catch (e: Exception) {
136	                        e.printStackTrace()
137	                    }
138	                }
139	                PROTO_VER_BROTLI -> {
140	                    // Brotli 解压后递归解析
141	                    try {
142	                        val decompressed = decompressBrotli(body)
143	                        packets.addAll(decode(decompressed))
144	                    } catch (e: Exception) {
145	                        e.printStackTrace()
146	                    }
147	                }
148	                else -> {
149	                    // 未知版本，保留但不处理内容
150	                    packets.add(Packet(version, operation, sequence, body))
151	                }
152	            }
153	        }
154	        
155	        packets
156	    }
157	    
158	    /**
159	     * Zlib 解压
160	     */
161	    private fun decompressZlib(data: ByteArray): ByteArray {
162	        val outputStream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
163	        val inflaterOutputStream = InflaterOutputStream(outputStream)
164	        inflaterOutputStream.write(data)
165	        inflaterOutputStream.close()
166	        return outputStream.toByteArray()
167	    }
168	    
169	    /**
170	     * Brotli 解压
171	     */
172	    private fun decompressBrotli(data: ByteArray): ByteArray {
173	        val inputStream = ByteArrayInputStream(data)
174	        val brotliInputStream = BrotliInputStream(inputStream)
175	        val outputStream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
176	        
177	        val buffer = ByteArray(4096)
178	        var len: Int
179	        while (brotliInputStream.read(buffer).also { len = it } != -1) {
180	            outputStream.write(buffer, 0, len)
181	        }
182	        
183	        brotliInputStream.close()
184	        return outputStream.toByteArray()
185	    }
186	}
187	
```

14	    val maxBlurLevel: Int,
15	    val backgroundAlphaMultiplier: Float,
16	    val allowRealtime: Boolean
17	)
18	
19	internal fun resolveBlurBudget(
20	    surfaceType: BlurSurfaceType,
21	    motionTier: MotionTier,
22	    isScrolling: Boolean,
23	    isTransitionRunning: Boolean,
24	    forceLowBudget: Boolean = false
25	): BlurBudget {
26	    var maxBlurLevel = when (surfaceType) {
27	        BlurSurfaceType.HEADER -> 2
28	        BlurSurfaceType.DRAWER_OR_SHEET -> 2
29	        BlurSurfaceType.BOTTOM_BAR -> 1
30	        BlurSurfaceType.OVERLAY -> 1
31	        BlurSurfaceType.GENERIC -> 1
32	    }
33	    var backgroundAlphaMultiplier = when (surfaceType) {
34	        BlurSurfaceType.HEADER -> 1.0f
35	        BlurSurfaceType.DRAWER_OR_SHEET -> 1.0f
36	        BlurSurfaceType.BOTTOM_BAR -> 0.95f
37	        BlurSurfaceType.OVERLAY -> 0.92f
38	        BlurSurfaceType.GENERIC -> 0.95f
39	    }
40	    var allowRealtime = true
41	
42	    when (motionTier) {
43	        MotionTier.Reduced -> {
44	            maxBlurLevel = 0
45	            backgroundAlphaMultiplier *= 0.9f
46	            allowRealtime = false
47	        }
48	
49	        MotionTier.Normal -> Unit
50	        MotionTier.Enhanced -> Unit
51	    }
52	
53	    if (isScrolling) {
54	        if (surfaceType != BlurSurfaceType.HEADER) {
55	            maxBlurLevel = minOf(maxBlurLevel, 0)
56	            backgroundAlphaMultiplier *= 0.92f
57	        }
58	        allowRealtime = false
59	    }
60	
61	    if (isTransitionRunning) {
62	        if (surfaceType != BlurSurfaceType.HEADER) {
63	            maxBlurLevel = minOf(maxBlurLevel, 0)
64	            backgroundAlphaMultiplier *= 0.92f
65	        }
66	        allowRealtime = false
67	    }
68	
69	    if (forceLowBudget) {
70	        maxBlurLevel = 0
71	        backgroundAlphaMultiplier *= 0.9f
72	        allowRealtime = false
73	    }
74	
75	    return BlurBudget(
76	        maxBlurLevel = maxBlurLevel.coerceIn(0, 2),
77	        backgroundAlphaMultiplier = backgroundAlphaMultiplier.coerceIn(0.70f, 1.10f),
78	        allowRealtime = allowRealtime
79	    )
80	}

4	
5	internal fun shouldContinueDynamicFetchAfterFilter(
6	    accumulatedVisibleCount: Int,
7	    hasMore: Boolean,
8	    previousOffset: String,
9	    nextOffset: String,
10	    pagesFetched: Int,
11	    maxPages: Int = DYNAMIC_EMPTY_PAGE_FETCH_LIMIT
12	): Boolean {

19	    if (next.isBlank()) return false
20	    if (next == previous) return false
21	
22	    return true

34	internal fun resolveReplyFraudStatus(
35	    guestProbe: CommentPresenceProbe,
36	    authProbe: CommentPresenceProbe,
37	    confirmedNotFoundAfterRetry: Boolean
38	): CommentFraudStatus {
39	    if (guestProbe.requestSucceeded && guestProbe.found) {
40	        return CommentFraudStatus.NORMAL
41	    }
42	
43	    if (authProbe.requestSucceeded && authProbe.found) {
44	        return if (guestProbe.requestSucceeded) {
45	            CommentFraudStatus.SHADOW_BANNED
46	        } else {
47	            CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
48	        }
49	    }
50	
51	    if (!authProbe.requestSucceeded) {
52	        return CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
53	    }
54	
55	    if (authProbe.deletedHint || confirmedNotFoundAfterRetry) {
56	        return CommentFraudStatus.DELETED
57	    }
58	
59	    return CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
60	}

62	internal fun resolveRootFraudStatusFromTimeline(
63	    guestTimelineProbe: CommentPresenceProbe,
64	    authReplyPageProbe: CommentReplyPageProbe,
65	    guestReplyPageProbe: CommentReplyPageProbe?,
66	    confirmedDeletedAfterRetry: Boolean
67	): CommentFraudStatus {
68	    if (guestTimelineProbe.requestSucceeded && guestTimelineProbe.found) {
69	        return CommentFraudStatus.NORMAL
70	    }
71	
72	    if (!guestTimelineProbe.requestSucceeded || !authReplyPageProbe.requestSucceeded) {
73	        return CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
74	    }
75	
76	    if (authReplyPageProbe.deletedHint) {
77	        return if (confirmedDeletedAfterRetry) {
78	            CommentFraudStatus.DELETED
79	        } else {
80	            CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
81	        }
82	    }
83	
84	    if (!authReplyPageProbe.visible) {
85	        return CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
86	    }
87	
88	    if (guestReplyPageProbe == null || !guestReplyPageProbe.requestSucceeded) {
89	        return CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
90	    }
91	
92	    return when {
93	        guestReplyPageProbe.visible -> CommentFraudStatus.UNDER_REVIEW
94	        guestReplyPageProbe.deletedHint -> CommentFraudStatus.SHADOW_BANNED
95	        else -> CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
96	    }
97	}
98	
99	internal fun resolveRootFraudStatus(
100	    guestSeekProbe: CommentPresenceProbe,
101	    authSeekProbe: CommentPresenceProbe,
102	    guestReplyPageVisible: Boolean?,
103	    confirmedNotFoundAfterRetry: Boolean
104	): CommentFraudStatus {
105	    if (guestSeekProbe.requestSucceeded && guestSeekProbe.found) {
106	        return CommentFraudStatus.NORMAL
107	    }
108	
109	    if (authSeekProbe.requestSucceeded && authSeekProbe.found) {
110	        if (!guestSeekProbe.requestSucceeded) return CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
111	        return when (guestReplyPageVisible) {
112	            true -> CommentFraudStatus.UNDER_REVIEW
113	            false -> CommentFraudStatus.SHADOW_BANNED
114	            null -> CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
115	        }
116	    }
117	
118	    if (!authSeekProbe.requestSucceeded) {
119	        return CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
120	    }
121	
122	    if (authSeekProbe.deletedHint || confirmedNotFoundAfterRetry) {
123	        return CommentFraudStatus.DELETED
124	    }
125	
126	    return CommentFraudStatus.UNKNOWN
127	}
